name: Complaint draft-text → formal-logic → theorem-prover pipeline
description: Orchestrates the full five-step proof pipeline for a complaint draft body: (A) text_to_fol, (B) legal_text_to_deontic, (C) constrain_assertions_to_corpus, (D) prove_claim_elements, (E) check_policy_rules_with_deontic_norms. Returns a DraftProofReport with proof_status, contradictions, corpus coverage, deontic norms, policy violations, and Lean 4 / Coq theorem exports.

pipeline_steps.name: text_to_fol
pipeline_steps.description: Convert draft body to FOL predicates.

pipeline_steps.name: legal_text_to_deontic
pipeline_steps.description: Extract deontic norms from the draft.

pipeline_steps.name: constrain_assertions_to_corpus
pipeline_steps.description: Ground FOL assertions against the legal corpus.

pipeline_steps.name: prove_claim_elements
pipeline_steps.description: Run hybrid reasoner + Z3 SMT proof.

body.description: The full draft complaint body text.

allow_live_scrape_fallback.description: Whether to permit live-scrape calls for corpus searches.

theorem_export.description: Lean 4 and Coq exports of the TDFOL/DCEC formula set.
